department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 for fall PhD admission; all applicants are considered for aid.
deadline.quote: Dec. 15 is the deadline for Ph.D. applications to be considered for fall (September) admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: An admissions committee reviews the whole application; research assistantships come from individual faculty.
supervisor.quote: The admissions committee considers the entire application when making a decision

funding.value: Fellowships and assistantships are awarded at admission, with PhD students given the highest priority; not every admit is funded.
funding.quote: There are a number of fellowships and assistantships available within the department. All applicants will be considered for all such opportunities. Ph.D. students receive the highest priority.

entry_route.value: You can start the PhD after a bachelor's (five to six years) or a master's (three to five years).
entry_route.quote: The Ph.D. degree typically takes five to six years after the Bachelor of Science or three to five years after the Master of Science.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay $148: the $90 Texas A&M fee plus the $58 EngineeringCAS fee.
app_fee.quote: International Applicants: $148 - Texas A&M University fee ($90) + EngineeringCAS Processing Fee ($58)

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot waive or pay the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: The fee is required by Admissions and EngineeringCAS. We cannot pay the fee for you either.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional; scores can help applicants with a lower GPA or from less familiar schools.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for all applicants.

notes: Applications via EngineeringCAS. TOEFL iBT below 100 makes admission unlikely, per the FAQ.
